content.text: Come thou … into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous, Gen. 7:1. If I find in Sodom fifty righteous, Gen. 18:26. She hath been more righteous than I, Gen. 38:26. innocent and righteous slay thou not, Ex. 23:7. Let me die the death of the righteous, Num. 23:10. judges … shall justify the righteous, Deut. 25:1. reason with you … of all the righteous acts of the Lord, 1 Sam. 12:7. God of Israel, thou art righteous, Ezra 9:15 (Neh. 9:8; Rev. 16:5). Lord knoweth the way of the righteous, Ps. 1:6. Lord, wilt bless the righteous, Ps. 5:12. Lord trieth the righteous, Ps. 11:5. judgments of the Lord are true and righteous, Ps. 19:9. eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, Ps. 34:15 (1 Pet. 3:12). righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, Ps. 34:17. little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches, Ps. 37:16. yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, Ps. 37:25. mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, Ps. 37:30. he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved, Ps. 55:22. In his days shall the righteous flourish, Ps. 72:7. salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous, Ps. 118:15. Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous, Ps. 119:138. Lord is righteous in all his ways, Ps. 145:17. mouth of a righteous man is a well of life, Prov. 10:11. labour of the righteous tendeth to life, Prov. 10:16. lips of the righteous feed many, Prov. 10:21. righteous shall never be removed, Prov. 10:30. righteous is delivered out of trouble, Prov. 11:8. righteous man regardeth the life of his beast, Prov. 12:10. righteous man hateth lying, Prov. 13:5. wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, Prov. 21:18. righteous are bold as a lion, Prov. 28:1. When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice, Prov. 29:2. Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well, Isa. 3:10. raised up the righteous man from the east, Isa. 41:2. shall my righteous servant justify many, Isa. 53:11. Thy people also shall be all righteous, Isa. 60:21. I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, Jer. 23:5. When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness … he shall die, Ezek. 3:20 (18:24, 26; 33:18). warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, Ezek. 3:21. God is righteous in all his works, Dan. 9:14. they sold the righteous for silver, Amos 2:6. discern between the righteous and the wicked, Mal. 3:18 (3 Ne. 24:18).

not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance, Matt. 9:13 (Mark 2:17; Luke 5:32; Moro. 8:8). he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man, Matt. 10:41. righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, Matt. 13:17. righteous shine forth as the sun, Matt. 13:43. outwardly appear righteous unto men, Matt. 23:28. upon you may come all the righteous blood, Matt. 23:35. shall go away … the righteous into life eternal, Matt. 25:46. trusted in themselves that they were righteous, Luke 18:9. Certainly this was a righteous man, Luke 23:47. judge righteous judgment, John 7:24. There is none righteous, no, not one, Rom. 3:10. scarcely for a righteous man will one die, Rom. 5:7. by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous, Rom. 5:19. law is not made for a righteous man, 1 Tim. 1:9. Abel … obtained witness that he was righteous, Heb. 11:4. fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much, James 5:16. if the righteous scarcely be saved, 1 Pet. 4:18. seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul, 2 Pet. 2:8. we have an advocate … Jesus Christ the righteous, 1 Jn. 2:1. he that doeth righteousness is righteous, 1 Jn. 3:7. his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous, 1 Jn. 3:12. he that is righteous, let him be righteous still, Rev. 22:11.

he that is righteous is favored of God, 1 Ne. 17:35. he will preserve the righteous, 1 Ne. 22:17. righteous … inherit the kingdom, 2 Ne. 9:18. words of truth are hard … but the righteous fear them not, 2 Ne. 9:40. raise up unto me a righteous branch, Jacob 2:25. names of the righteous shall be written in the book of life, Alma 5:58. plans to pervert the ways of the righteous, Alma 10:18. in the hearts of the righteous doth he dwell, Alma 34:36. spirits of … righteous are received into a state of happiness, Alma 40:12. ye shall have a righteous judgment restored unto you, Alma 41:14. Lord suffereth the righteous to be slain, Alma 60:13. Condemning the righteous because of their righteousness, Hel. 7:5. if it were not for the righteous … fire should come down, Hel. 13:13. righteous judgment might come upon them, Hel. 14:29. more righteous part of the people had nearly all become wicked, 3 Ne. 7:7 (9:13; 10:12). he that is righteous shall be righteous still, Morm. 9:14.

cannot always judge the righteous, D&C 10:37. righteous shall be gathered on my right hand, D&C 29:27. righteous shall be gathered out from among all nations, D&C 45:71. cometh an entire separation of the righteous, D&C 63:54. that which is righteous cometh down from above, D&C 67:9. by this you may know the righteous from the wicked, D&C 84:53. righteous shall inherit it, D&C 88:26 (88:16–26). ordained … and were righteous and holy men, D&C 107:29. among the righteous there was peace, D&C 138:22. among the righteous, he organized his forces, D&C 138:30.
Jesus Christ, a righteous Judge, Moses 6:57. The Righteous is lifted up, Moses 7:47. he saw the day of the righteous, Moses 7:67. Pharaoh, being a righteous man, established his kingdom, Abr. 1:26.
